name: DR CONGO

flag.title: DRC Flag
flag.note: Sky blue, diagonal red stripe edged gold

lead: DR Congo is a giant rainforest country in the heart of Africa. The Congo River winds through jungles so vast they act like a second lung for our planet. Phones and batteries around the world use its minerals.

sections.geography: A river runs through it all
sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: The Congo River loops through the country like a giant question mark. It drains a rainforest the size of Western Europe. Rain falls almost daily, so the rivers stay full.
In the east, volcanoes and the Rwenzori Mountains rise high. People call them the Mountains of the Moon. Glaciers cap them, right on the equator.
animals: The okapi lives wild only in DR Congo. This shy relative of the giraffe has zebra stripes. Mountain gorillas cling on in the Virunga volcanoes.
Bonobos, our closest ape relatives, live only in forests south of the Congo River. So does the Congo peacock, found nowhere else. Over 700 fish species swim in the river.
culture: Congo gave the world soukous, bouncy electric-guitar music. It swept across Africa in the 1970s. In Kinshasa, sapeurs (fashion fans) wear spectacular suits. For them, it is living art and peaceful protest.
Over 200 ethnic groups live here. They carve wooden masks for ceremonies that link the living with their ancestors. People wear colourful wax-print cloth called kitenge every day.
history: The Kongo Kingdom ruled much of Central Africa for centuries. In the 1880s, Belgian King Leopold II seized the land. He forced people to harvest rubber, and millions died.

Congo became independent on 30 June 1960. Its leader, Patrice Lumumba, gave a speech demanding true freedom. Decades of harsh one-leader rule followed. Now elections are held, and mineral wealth offers hope.
wows: The Congo River is over 220 m deep, the deepest river on Earth.
DR Congo holds more than half of Africa's tropical rainforest.
The Congo River crosses the equator twice.
Kinshasa and Brazzaville are the world's closest pair of capital cities.
Most of the world's cobalt, a phone-battery metal, comes from DR Congo.
Bonobos are the only great apes known to be led by females.
Mount Nyiragongo holds one of Earth's largest lava lakes.

myths.myth: The Congo is Africa's longest river
myths.fact: The Nile is longer. The Congo is second. But the Congo carries far more water.
Gorillas are gentle. They mostly eat plants, like leaves, stems and fruit.
